`final class ClasspathAsset`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Asset`](/reference/resources/asset/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.asset.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ClasspathAsset.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/asset/impl/ClasspathAsset.java)

An asset found in the classpath, such as a file packed in the jar of your application.

## Description

A `String` path without a scheme gives one when the classpath has it, with or without a leading `/`; its id is `classpath:` followed by the path.
